title: Add "Add to Cart" Button on Product Listing Page
acceptance_criteria: Button Visibility: An "Add to Cart" button must be displayed on every product card in the product listing/catalog view.
Action & Feedback: When clicked, the item is successfully added to the user's shopping cart.
Action & Feedback: A visual indicator (e.g., a toast notification like "Item added to cart!" or a quick button state change to "Added ✓") is shown to the user.
Action & Feedback: The cart icon counter in the website header updates dynamically in real-time to reflect the new item count.
Inventory Handling: If a product is out of stock, the button should be disabled and labeled as "Out of Stock".
Guest vs. Logged-in Users: For guest users, the cart items must be stored in local storage/session.
Guest vs. Logged-in Users: For logged-in users, the cart items must sync with the backend database.
